description: The caption of a color rule as a saved color table or a saved Session is read (PD-OI-042 scenario revision 2, accepted residual risk). Builds between first-parent `main` fe6861f0 and the naming rule rewrote one caption written with several colors to `caption [fill]`, the fill being the rule's color as lower-case #rrggbb (a color name or #rgb resolved) or `none`, and saved the rewritten caption in the Session and in the downloaded color-table TSV. A caption that ends in ` [fill]` of its own rule's color is read without it, once; any other caption is read as written, also one that would be left blank. Python's answer is gbdraw/legend/table.py::saved_rule_caption (tests/test_specific_color_captions.py); the Web app's is services/specific-color-rules.js::savedRuleCaption (tests/web/specific-color-actions.test.mjs).
